text:
mina: Pushed a minimal Vite+React sample that demonstrates running LlamaClient in edge + SSR against Redwood API. Need feedback on auth+retry behavior in browser vs server.

raj: Nice. Link?

mina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/vite-llamaclient-starter (draft)

alyssa: Quick notes: browser SDK doesn't expose streaming in our current build — is that intended?

sam: Yeah streaming is only wired in node runtime right now. We need EventSource fallback for browsers.

luis: Re: auth, I noticed the sample uses REDWOOD_API_KEY in client env. That's risky. Should show server proxy for refresh.

mina: Good catch. I used it for simplicity but we should show two patterns: server-side token exchange + ephemeral keys in client.

raj: Also saw retries behaving differently between edge/SSR. The client SDK backoff is jittered, but edge runtime swallows 401 and doesn't retry.

sam: Edge issue: middleware dropped the Authorization header on subrequests. Fix is to forward headers or use signed cookie.

alyssa: Proposed small code snippet for server proxy:

```
// pages/api/llama-proxy.js
export default async (req, res) => {
  const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY}` },
    body: req.body
  });
  r.body.pipe(res);
}
```

mina: Added an eval harness that runs 50 prompts and checks token stability. CI is failing on it though — looks flaky.

devex-bot: CI pipeline #4723 failed on `vite-llamaclient-starter` (timeout 10m) :warning:

luis: The harness opens a streaming connection and times out if no chunks in 3s — in CI we should relax to 10s or mock streaming.

raj: For SDK parity, can we add a test matrix: node/browser/edge and snapshot streaming frames?

mina: Yup I'll add matrix and update docs to avoid direct client key usage. Planning a follow-up PR for EventSource polyfill.

sam: If anyone wants to pair on the proxy pattern + docs ping me. :thumbsup:

alyssa: LGTM. Small TODOs: amend README, add security note, CI timeout tweak.

mina: Thanks all — will iterate and post PR link.
